body:
Hi @Haroenv !
Its still problematic with version 3.4.0. It do not give errors but the sort by is not still working fine. This widget disappears (dropdown menu) after some delay i-e 2-3 seconds. When page loads it is like this: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/16lTszOQHoNhUTPdVe63CmUmqpt-wK0G\_/view?usp=sharing](dropdownPresent)

After some time span it disappears: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EIGzJDuUNK9CdMZhXQccle73MXjoLRUk/view?usp=sharing](dropdownDisappears)

This was also happening previously when created this issue, but also give errors on browser's console. Now there is no error on console.

I shifted to previous version of instantsearch.js by using resolutions in package.json.

```
"resolutions": {
 "instantsearch.js": "3.4.0",
},
```
